[The candidate patch](2026-09-26-wide-rvv-fa.patch) adds . It sends only 256/256 F16 K/V batches with at least 16 query tokens to the existing RVV **tiled** implementation. Single-token and short-tail decoding keep the generic path. The 256-wide one-chunk RVV implementation is deliberately excluded: it contains vector loads with a 128-lane maximum and has not been adapted for 256 elements. The tiled helpers loop across the dimension, and the patch extends only their shape assertion. The wide path uses its per-thread work buffer instead of the shared TCM pointer. Thus the wide path does not depend on the TCM capacity or the sharing semantics. It also allocates the cache-line padding already used by each tiled worker in both CPU work-size calculations.
